Rashi on Nazir 5a:10:1.hebrew: דילמא - האי דקאמר ד' ימים בשנה, הכי הוי: לסוף ד' ירחין חד זימנא, ולתרין [ירחין] חד זימנא, ולארבע ירחין חד זימנא, ולתרין ירחין חד זימנא — דהיינו נמי ארבע זימנין. והילכך, הואיל ואיכא למימר הכי ואיכא למימר הכי, שבקינן ההוא קרא דלא מפרש, וגמרינן מקרא דמפרש — דהיינו מבתי ערי חומה:
Rashi on Nazir 5a:10:1.english: Perhaps - That which [the verse] states, “four days in a year,” was as follows: At the end of four months, one time; and after two [months], one time; and after four months, one time; and after two months, one time — which is also four times [in a year]. And therefore, since it is possible to say this and it is possible to say that, we leave aside that verse, which is not explicit, and we derive [it] from a verse that is explicit — that is, from [the law of] houses in walled cities.

Rashi on Nazir 5a:11:2.hebrew: מידי הוא טעמא - דאמרינן דמגלחין בשלשים יום, אלא משום דאיכא כובד שיער והוה ליה ניוול? הכא נמי איכא כובד, ומשום הכי היה אומר רבי נהוראי דאבשלום היה מגלח לאחר שלשים יום:
Rashi on Nazir 5a:11:2.english: Is the reason - that we say [priests] cut their hair at thirty days [anything] other than because there is a heaviness of hair and it is a disfigurement? Here too, there is heaviness; and on account of this, Rabbi Nehorai would say that Absalom would cut his hair after thirty days.

Rashi on Nazir 5a:12:1.hebrew: לדברי רבי יוסי, דאמר שמגלח מערב שבת לערב שבת — מאי היכרא איכא בין דידיה, דהוי נזיר, לשאר אחין? הא אינהו נמי נוהגין להסתפר בכך:
Rashi on Nazir 5a:12:1.english: According to the words of Rabbi Yosei, who said that he would cut [his hair] from Shabbat eve to Shabbat eve — what distinction is there between him, who was a nazirite, and [his] other brothers? Behold, they too are accustomed to cut their hair in this manner.

Rashi on Nazir 5a:12:2.hebrew: איכא בינייהו - בזמן שחל יו"ט להיות באמצע שבת, דאחין מגלחין בערב יום טוב, והוא אינו מגלח עד ערב שבת. ואי קשיא לך: ולרבי, מאי שנא אבשלום משאר נזירי עולם דמסתפרים אחת לל' יום משום דלגבי דידהו הוי כובד? ורבי מתרץ לטעמיה: דאבשלום, הואיל ובעל כח הוה, לא הוה כובד לדידיה עד שנים עשר חדש, כי כאיש גבורתו. ולרבי יוסי: הואיל דאורחייהו דבני מלכים להסתפר מערב שבת לערב שבת, הוה ליה כובד כשאר אחין, אבל לשאר אינשי ליכא כובד עד ל':
Rashi on Nazir 5a:12:2.english: There is [a difference] between them - When a Festival occurs in the middle of the week, as the brothers cut [their hair] on the eve of the Festival, but he does not cut [his hair] until Shabbat eve. And if you should object: According to Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi], how is Absalom different from other lifelong nazirites, who cut [their hair] once every thirty days because for them it is heavy? Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi] answers according to his reasoning: Since Absalom was a man of [great] strength, it was not heavy for him until twelve months [had passed], “for as the man is, so is his strength” (Judges 8:21). And according to Rabbi Yosei: Since it is the custom of kings' sons to cut [their hair] from Shabbat eve to Shabbat eve, it was [considered] heavy for him [after a week], just like the rest of [his] brothers; but for other people, there is no heaviness until thirty [days].

Rashi on Nazir 5a:14:1.hebrew: הני מ' שנה - דכתיב: "ויהי מקץ מ' שנה":
Rashi on Nazir 5a:14:1.english: These forty years - As it is written: “And it came to pass at the end of forty years” (II Samuel 15:7).

Rashi on Nazir 5a:14:2.hebrew: מאי עבידתייהו - והלא לא היו למלכות בית דוד אלא ל"ז:
Rashi on Nazir 5a:14:2.english: What is their purpose - For were there not only thirty-seven [years] of the reign of the House of David [at that point]?

Rashi on Nazir 5a:14:3.hebrew: לקץ מ' שנה ששאלו להם מלך - היא שנת עשר לשמואל הרמתי, שאבשלום היה יודע שעתיד דוד למלאות מ' שנה. וכשנתמלאו מ' שנה ששאלו ישראל מלך מיום ליום — אחר שמלכו שמואל ושאול, דהיינו בתחילת המלכות, ועלתה לשניהן, לפי שעדיין לא יצא טיבעו של שאול בעולם, ואף טיבעו של שמואל בעולם שהיה נקרא מלך לא פסק; ושתים שמלך שאול בעצמו בחיי שמואל, כמו שלמדנו [בסדר עולם] שלא מת שמואל לפני שאול אלא ד' חדשים; ול"ז שמלך דוד — וטעה אבשלום ואמר: "עכשיו הגיע הקץ של אבא, ואלכה לחברון להסב לי שם המלוכה". ואם נפש אדם לומר: "מנין אתה אומר שאותה שנה שמלכו שמואל ושאול שהיתה בתחילת מלכות של שאול, ושמואל לא מת לפני שאול אלא ד' חדשים?" — מכאן אתה למד: שבאותו יום שעלתה חנה לשילה, דכתיב: "ועלי הכהן יושב על הכסא" (שמואל א א׳:ט׳), באותו יום נתמנה לשופט, והיינו דכתיב "ישב על הכסא"; ולמדנו שבאותה שנה נתעברה חנה וילדה שמואל; ונאמר בו בשמואל (שם): "וישב שם עד עולם" — עד עולמו של יובל, נ' שנים, ושתי שנים שגמלתו אמו; הרי לך שנים של שמואל נ"ב שנים. ועלי, כמה שנים נתמנה על ישראל? מ' שנה. וכשהיה לו לעלי ארבעים שנה, בן כמה שנים היה שמואל? הוי אומר: בן ל"ט שנה, שצריך אתה להוציא שנה אחת לעיבורו. כמה נשתיירו לו משנותיו של שמואל? י"ג. צא מהן עשר שמלך שמואל אחר מיתתו של עלי, ונשתיירו להן ג' שנים. זו היא שאמרו: אחת שמלך שאול ושמואל, ושתים שמלך שאול בעצמו:
Rashi on Nazir 5a:14:3.english: At the end of forty years since they requested for themselves a king - This was the tenth year of Samuel the Ramathite. For Absalom knew that David was destined to complete forty years [of reign]; and when forty years from when Israel requested a king were completed, to the exact day — [namely, the one year] after Samuel and Saul reigned [together], that is, at the beginning of the monarchy, which was credited to both of them, because Saul’s renown had not yet spread throughout the world, and Samuel’s renown in the world, that he was called king, had not ceased; and two [years] that Saul reigned by himself during Samuel’s lifetime, as we learned [in Seder Olam] that Samuel died before Saul by only four months; and thirty-seven [years] that David reigned — Absalom erred and said: “Now the end of father’s [reign] has arrived, so I will go to Hebron to turn the monarchy over to myself there.” And if a person wishes to say: “From where do you say that that year which Samuel and Saul reigned was at the beginning of Saul’s reign, and that Samuel died before Saul by only four months?” — from here you learn [it]: For on that [very] day that Hannah went up to Shiloh, as it is written: “Now Eli the priest sat upon the seat” (I Samuel 1:9), on that day he was appointed judge, and that is why it is written “sat upon the seat”; and we learned that in that year Hannah conceived and gave birth to Samuel; and it is said concerning him, concerning Samuel: “and abide there forever” (ibid. [1:22]) — until the “ever” of a Jubilee, [which is] fifty years, and two years that his mother nursed him; behold you have Samuel’s years [as] fifty-two years. And Eli, for how many years was he appointed over Israel? Forty years. And when Eli reached forty years, how old was Samuel? You must say: thirty-nine years old, for you must deduct one year for [Hannah’s] pregnancy. How many [years] remained of Samuel’s years? Thirteen. Deduct from them ten [years] that Samuel ruled after the death of Eli, and there remained of them three years. This is what they said: one [year] that Saul and Samuel reigned [together], and two [years] that Saul reigned by himself.

Rashi on Nazir 5a:17:1.hebrew: בר פדא אמר כנגד נזיר נזרו ונדר נדרו - האמור בפ' נזיר, שהן ל' חסר אחת: לנדור, נדר, נזיר, להזיר, יזיר, נזרו, נדר, נזרו, יזיר, הזירו, נזרו, נזרו, והזיר, נזרו, נזרו, הנזיר, נזרו, הנזיר, נזרו, נזרו, הנזיר, נזרו, הנזיר, הנזיר, ידור, נזרו, נדרו, ידור, נזרו — הרי ל' חסר אחת. "נזר אלהיו" לא קחשיב, לפי שאינו לשון נזירות אלא לשון עטרה, כמו התרגום:
Rashi on Nazir 5a:17:1.english: Bar Padda said: Corresponding to “nazirite,” “his naziriteship,” and “vow,” “his vow” - [The terms] stated in the portion of the Nazirite, which are thirty less one: lindor [to vow], neder [a vow], nazir [a nazirite], lehazir [to consecrate], yazir [he shall consecrate], nizro [his naziriteship], neder [the vow of], nizro [his naziriteship], yazir [he consecrates], haziro [his consecration], nizro [his naziriteship], nizro [his naziriteship], vehizir [and he shall consecrate], nizro [his naziriteship], nizro [his naziriteship], hanazir [the nazirite], nizro [his naziriteship], hanazir [the nazirite], nizro [his naziriteship], nizro [his naziriteship], hanazir [the nazirite], nizro [his naziriteship], hanazir [the nazirite], hanazir [the nazirite], yiddor [he vows], nizro [his naziriteship], nidro [his vow], yiddor [he vows], nizro [his naziriteship] — behold, [these are] thirty less one. [The phrase] “the crown of his God” [nezer Elohav] is not counted, because it is not an expression of naziriteship, but rather an expression of a crown, as [rendered in] the Targum.

Rashi on Nazir 5a:19:1.hebrew: נזיר להזיר מלמד שהנזירות חלה על נזירות - שאם אמר: "הריני נזיר אם אוכל ככר זו", וחזר ואמר: "הריני נזיר אם אוכל ככר זו", ואכלה — מונה שתי נזירות; דאף על גב דככר אחד הוא, חלה נזירות על נזירות. וכיון דהני אתו לדרשא ולא למניינא, אחריני נמי לאו למניינא אתו:
Rashi on Nazir 5a:19:1.english: “A nazirite, to consecrate himself” teaches that naziriteship takes effect upon naziriteship - For if one said: “Behold, I am a nazirite if I eat this loaf,” and repeated and said: “Behold, I am a nazirite if I eat this loaf,” and he ate it, he counts two [terms of] naziriteship; for even though it is one loaf, naziriteship takes effect upon [the existing] naziriteship. And since these [words] come for an exposition and not for counting, the others also did not come for counting.

Rashi on Nazir 5a:1:1.hebrew: ויליף מבתי ערי חומה - דכתיב בהו: ״ימים תהיה גאולתו״. מה להלן י"ב חדש — כדמפרש ביה קרא: ״ואם לא יגאל עד מלאת לו שנה תמימה״:
Rashi on Nazir 5a:1:1.english: And he derives [it] from houses of walled cities - For it is written concerning them: “For a full year [yamim] he shall have the right of redemption” (Leviticus 25:29). Just as there [it means] twelve months — as Scripture explains regarding it: “And if it is not redeemed until a full year has elapsed for him” (Leviticus 25:30).

Rashi on Nazir 5a:2:1.english: Rabbi Nehorai says - Absalom would cut [his hair] once every thirty days.

Rashi on Nazir 5a:2:2.english: As we find with the sons of kings - For such is their practice.

Rashi on Nazir 5a:3:1.hebrew: והא רבי הוא דאמר - במס' ערכין (דף לא.): ימים תהיה גאולתו — אין ימים פחותים משנים, שאם בא לגאלה באותו יום שמשכנה לו, אינו יכול לגאלה עד שיעברו עליו ב' ימים, לפי שאין מקרא יוצא מידי פשוטו. והכא נמי, מאי חזא רבי מההוא ג"ש — מה להלן י"ב חדש כו'? נגמר מהאי טעמא, ונימא נמי דאבשלום מגלח היה לשני ימים:
Rashi on Nazir 5a:3:1.english: But isn’t it Rabbi who said - In Tractate Arakhin (31a): "[Concerning the verse,] 'Its redemption shall be days' — 'days' is not fewer than two [days]; for if he came to redeem it on the [same] day that he mortgaged it to him, he cannot redeem it until two days have passed for it, because a verse does not depart from its plain meaning." And here too, what did Rabbi see [to derive] from that verbal analogy [gezeirah shavah], "Just as there [it is] twelve months, etc."? Let us derive from this reasoning, and let us say as well that Absalom would cut his hair every two days!

Rashi on Nazir 5a:4:1.hebrew: הא ג"ש - דגמיר מבתי ערי חומה:
Rashi on Nazir 5a:4:1.english: This verbal analogy - Which he derives from houses of walled cities.

Rashi on Nazir 5a:4:2.english: It is because of weight that he learned [it] - For it is written concerning him, regarding Absalom: “Because it was heavy on him, he cut it.”

Rashi on Nazir 5a:4:3.english: And in two days there is no weight - And because of this, he did not derive [it] from it.

Rashi on Nazir 5a:5:1.hebrew: ולימא דשתי שנים - משמע האי "מקץ ימים לימים אשר יגלח", דשתי שנים נמי איקרו ימים, כדכתיב: "ויהי מקץ שנתים ימים":
Rashi on Nazir 5a:5:1.english: And let [us] say that [it means] two years - Does this [verse], “from the end of yamim to yamim that he would cut [his hair],” imply [two years]? For two years are also called yamim, as it is written: “And it came to pass at the end of two years of days [yamim]” (Genesis 41:1).

Rashi on Nazir 5a:6:1.hebrew: ואימא שלשים יום - דשלשים איקרו ימים, כדכתיב: "עד חדש ימים":
Rashi on Nazir 5a:6:1.english: And say thirty days - For thirty [days] are called "days," as it is written: "Until a month of days."

Rashi on Nazir 5a:7:1.hebrew: ואימא מהכא מימים ימימה - תלכנה בנות ישראל לתנות לבת יפתח ד' ימים בשנה, דהיינו יום א' לשלשה חדשים. הכא נמי נימא דמגלח היה אבשלום לג' חדשים. לתנות — לשון תאניה ואניה (איכה ב):
Rashi on Nazir 5a:7:1.english: And say from here: "From time to time [yamim yamima]" - "[The daughters of Israel went] to lament the daughter of Jephthah four days in a year" (Judges 11:40), that is, one day every three months. Here too, let us say that Absalom would shave [once] every three months. "To lament [letannot]" — an expression of mourning and grief [ta'aniyya va'aniyya] (Lamentations 2).

Rashi on Nazir 5a:8:1.hebrew: ושב הכהן ובא הכהן זו היא שיבה זו היא ביאה - מה ביאה מביתו של כהן לבית המנוגע — חולץ וקוצה וטח ונותן שבוע להסגירו, אף כאן בשיבה. אף ה"נ, כיון דכתיב מימים ימימה, ליהוי נמי כמאן דאמר ימים:
Rashi on Nazir 5a:8:1.english: “And the priest shall return,” “and the priest shall come” — this is returning, this is coming - Just as [with] coming from the priest’s house to the afflicted house, [the priest] removes [the stones], scrapes [the house], plasters [it], and grants a week to quarantine it, so too here regarding returning. So too here: since it is written “from time to time” [yamim yamima], let it also be like one who said “days” [yamim].

Rashi on Nazir 5a:9:1.hebrew: א"ד - לא ילפינן מההוא קרא דכתיב בבת יפתח, דמנא ידעינן דמתלתא ירחין לתלתא ירחין הוי חד זימנא:
Rashi on Nazir 5a:9:1.english: Some say - We do not derive from that verse that is written concerning the daughter of Jephthah, for from where do we know that from three months to three months was one time?

Tosafot on Nazir 5a:11:1.hebrew: מ"ט גבי כהנים [דאיכא] כובד - וא"ת: והא כהני' עצמם ילפי' (תענית יז.) מסתם נזי' "פרע" "פרע", דמקילין אחת לשלשים יום; וא"כ, נילף נזיר עולם מסתם נזיר, דהוי שלשים יום? וי"ל: דלא מיסתבר ליה ללמוד קדושת עולם מקדושת שעה, ולהכי יליף מכהנים — אע"ג דלמד מן הלמד — משום דכהנים נמי קדושת עולם הוו:
Tosafot on Nazir 5a:11:1.english: What is the reason? With regard to priests, [it is because there is] weight - And if you say: But regarding the priests themselves, do we not derive (Ta'anit 17a) from a standard nazirite [via the verbal analogy of] "pera" [and] "pera" that they lighten [their hair] once every thirty days? And if so, let us derive [the rule for] a lifelong nazirite from a standard nazirite, which is thirty days! And one can say: It did not seem reasonable to him to derive permanent sanctity from temporary sanctity, and for this reason he derives [it] from priests — even though it is a derivation from a derivation — because priests are also [endowed with] permanent sanctity.

Tosafot on Nazir 5a:12:1.hebrew: מאי איכא ביניה לשאר אחוהי - וא"ת: ונימא דאיכא בינייהו קרבנות, דהוא מביא ולא הן? וי"ל, דה"ק: מאי איכא ביניה בתגלחת? דקאמר קרא: "ויהי מקץ ימים אשר יגלח", משום דבתגלחת היה מאחר:
Tosafot on Nazir 5a:12:1.english: What difference is there between him and the rest of his brothers - And if you should say: But let us say that there is [a difference] between them [regarding] sacrifices, as he brings [them] and they do not! And one can say that this is what [the Gemara] means: What difference is there between him [and them] with regard to [his] haircut? For the verse states: "And it was at the end of days that he polled [his hair]" (II Samuel 14:26), because with regard to [his] haircut he would delay.

Tosafot on Nazir 5a:14:1.hebrew: הני (מקץ) מ' שנה למאי - פי', דליכא למימר למ' שנה (למאי) למלכות בית דוד, דאז מרד אבשלום — דהא משמע קראי דהיה מלך ה' שנים אחר מעשה זה: ג' של רעב, ואחד שמנה ישראל, ואחד שהעמיד משמרות. ומשני: מקץ מ' שנה ששאלו להם מלך. (אלו) שמרדו במלכו של עולם, תלה מרידת [אבשלום בשאלתם להם מלך, שהיה שנת עשר] לשמואל. ובחצי י"א העמיד מלך, ומלך חצי י"א וב' שנים — הרי ד' שנים לשאלה. ובתחלת ל"ו למלכות בית דוד היא שנת מ' לשאלה, ואח"כ מרד אבשלום, והשנה ההיא היה שנת רעב, וגם אותה שנת מ' לשאלה; ואפי' מרד בתחלת שנת מ' לשאלה — ולאו דוקא מקץ מ' שנה:
Tosafot on Nazir 5a:14:1.english: "These (at the end of) forty years, to what [do they refer]?" - Explanation: For one cannot say [that it means] after forty years (to what) of the reign of the House of David, [and that] it was then that Absalom rebelled, for the verses indicate that he reigned for five years after this incident: three [years] of famine, and one in which he counted Israel, and one in which he established the [priestly] watches. And [the Gemara] answers: At the end of forty years [from when] they requested a king for themselves. [Because of those] who rebelled against the King of the Universe, [Scripture] linked the rebellion of [Absalom to their request for a king, which was the tenth year] of Samuel['s leadership]. And in the middle of the eleventh [year], he [Samuel] appointed a king, and he [Saul] reigned for the [second] half of the eleventh [year] and two [further] years — behold, four years from the request. And at the beginning of the thirty-sixth [year] of the reign of the House of David, that was the fortieth year from the request, and afterward Absalom rebelled. And that year was a year of famine, and that [year] too was the fortieth year from the request; and even if he rebelled at the beginning of the fortieth year from the request — [the phrase "at the end of forty years"] is not strictly [meaning] at the conclusion of forty years.

Tosafot on Nazir 5a:15:1.english: "Unspecified naziriteship is thirty days" - And in the Gemara [it] explains the reason.

Tosafot on Nazir 5a:17:1.hebrew: בר פדא אמר כנגד נזירות האמורין בתורה שהן ל' חסר אחת - פירוש: כתובים בפרשת נזיר, וכנגדן מושך סתם נזירות כ"ט יום, אע"ג דתמצא שלשים. וכשאתה יורד למניינם, יש לומר ד"נזר אלהיו על ראשו" לא הוי ממניינא, דהוא לשון כתר, כדמתרגמינן "כלילא":
Tosafot on Nazir 5a:17:1.english: "Bar Padda said: Corresponding to the [expressions of] naziriteship stated in the Torah, which are thirty less one" - Explanation: [Meaning, those] written in the Torah portion of the nazirite [Numbers 6], and corresponding to them, an unspecified naziriteship lasts twenty-nine days, even though you find thirty [such expressions]. And when you examine their count, it can be said that "the crown [nezer] of his God is upon his head" [Numbers 6:7] is not included in the count, for it is an expression of a crown, as we translate [in the Targum]: "kelila."

Tosafot on Nazir 5a:19:1.hebrew: הנהו לדרשא - וכיון דאתיין לדרשא, לא מצטרפין למניינא ומנינן להו כ"ט:
Tosafot on Nazir 5a:19:1.english: "Those are for an exposition" - And since they come for an exposition, they do not join the count, [such that] we could count them as twenty-nine.

Tosafot on Nazir 5a:19:2.hebrew: מלמד שהנזירות חל על הנזירות - דאי נראה: דאם אמר "הריני נזיר ונזיר" לא איצטריך, דמישתמע שפיר כשישלים נזירותו הראשון דמתחיל ומונה נזירות שני. וכי איצטריך קרא — להיכא דאמר "הריני נזיר היום ונזיר", דהוה לן למימר: לא חייל עליה אלא חד נזירות, כיון דאמר "היום"; להכי איצטריך קרא מיותר, שהנזירות חל על הנזירות. הואיל ואיכא חד מינייהו דלאו לדרשא — או אחד או עשרה, ולאו דוקא חד — מדההוא למניינא, כולהון למניינא; ונהי דאיכא בהו דרשא, מכל מקום אתו למניינא:
Tosafot on Nazir 5a:19:2.english: “Teaches that naziriteship takes effect upon naziriteship” - For it appears: That if one said, “Behold, I am a nazirite and a nazirite,” [a verse] would not be needed, as it is well understood that when he completes his first naziriteship, he begins and counts a second naziriteship. And when a verse was needed, [it was] for where he said, “Behold, I am a nazirite today, and a nazirite,” where we would have said [that] only one naziriteship takes effect upon him, since he said “today”; for this, a superfluous verse was needed, [to teach] that naziriteship takes effect upon naziriteship. Since there is [at least] one of them that is not [needed] for an exposition — whether [there is only] one or ten, and [saying] “one” is not exact — since that [one is free and] serves for the count, all of them [serve] for the count; and although there is an exposition [derived] from them, nevertheless they come for the count.

Tosafot on Nazir 5a:3:1.hebrew: אין ימים פחותים משנים - דדריש מ"ימים תהיה גאולתו", שאין המוכר יכול לגאול בפחות משני ימים. (והא א"ר כו') — הכי נמי דבכל ב' ימים יקל שערו?! ומשני: דבב' ימים ליכא כובד. ומסתמא לא נתקבל ג"ש אהני, אלא ממשמעות דימים, דהיינו שנה תהיה גאולתו — שגואל אחרי ב' ימים כל השנה, כדכתיב בתריה: "ואם לא יגאל עד מלאת לו שנה תמימה", אלמא דכל השנה גואל:
Tosafot on Nazir 5a:3:1.english: "[The term] yamim is not fewer than two" - For [Rabbi] expounds from "yamim he shall have the right of redemption" (Leviticus 25:29) that the seller cannot redeem [the house] in fewer than two days. ("And isn't it Rabbi who said, etc.") — [Meaning,] here too, [should he derive that] he would lighten his hair every two days?! And [the Gemara] answers that in two days there is no heaviness [of hair]. And presumably, the verbal analogy [gezeirah shavah] was not received regarding these [two days], but rather from the [primary] meaning of yamim, which is that his redemption shall be for a year — as he may redeem [it] throughout the year after [the first] two days, as it is written after it: "And if it is not redeemed until a full year has completed for him" (Leviticus 25:30), which proves that he may redeem [it] throughout the entire year.
